description: Source code implementing functions to convert operator enums to strings, and to check if operators are assignment or atomic functions, within the ANGLE project.

methods.name: GetOperatorString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a given operator enum.

methods.name: IsAssignment
methods.description: Checks if the given operator enum is an assignment operator.

methods.name: IsAtomicFunction
methods.description: Checks if the given operator enum is an atomic function.
